name: Nauru
title: Ceyo Nauru | Autonomous 24/7 AI Cloud Agents
description: Deploy autonomous AI agents in Nauru. Running 24/7 in cloud computers for regional trade, research, Telegram workflows, and coding even when offline.
h1: Supercharge Work Across Nauru with 24/7 AI
sub: Equip yourself with dedicated cloud AI agents that browse the web, write code, automate Telegram tasks, and monitor global operations continuously.
audience: Nauruan administrative professionals, maritime and freight coordinators, local retail business owners, fisheries teams, and remote specialists.
manifesto: In an isolated island economy where bandwidth and global time zones matter, Ceyo runs continuous cloud computers that work 24/7, keeping your operations connected to international markets even when your screen is switched off.

uses.d: Direct an agent to autonomously track cargo ship manifests, monitor regional shipping lines heading into Aiwo Harbour, and log schedule revisions into Google Sheets.
Streamline administrative tasks by having agents summarize multi-agency PDFs, coordinate project documentation, and draft structured briefs for government and community programs.
Deploy the autonomous browser to compare machinery parts, solar equipment, and hardware across Australian and Pacific suppliers, compiling landed cost estimates.

uses.t: Retail and Service Automation on Telegram
uses.d: Empower your local shop or business with Telegram bots that answer customer inquiries, verify stock availability, and forward orders directly to your team.
Schedule routines that monitor oceanic weather feeds, fuel pricing fluctuations, and regional maritime advisories, relaying real-time updates before crews depart.
Use the coding agent to create internal departmental tools, extract public registry data, and publish lightweight web portals hosted straight from your cloud computer.

steps.d: Select your plan and receive an isolated cloud computer that stays active around the clock.
Link your Telegram chats, email, spreadsheets, and favorite services across 1,000+ available integrations.
Assign autonomous browsing, research reports, or coding tasks to run automatically day and night.

chapters.d: While the island is just waking up, your autonomous agent checks regional shipping arrivals and satellite weather reports. A concise summary is waiting in your Telegram chat before your day begins.

Your bot launches its autonomous browser to source generator components from overseas distributors, filling in quote requests and comparing lead times. You review and approve the shortlist on your mobile device.

In Yaren, your staff brings a team of specialist bots into a Telegram group chat to parse budget figures and draft a grant application. The coding agent writes a script to validate every spreadsheet cell instantly.

Even if home power or Wi-Fi flickers out, your isolated cloud environment continues running its assigned routines. Market movements, emails, and server scripts keep executing silently without your phone.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost and is there a free trial?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription tiers: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every tier includes a 3-day free trial with up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; your linked card is only billed after the trial ends unless cancelled.

faq.q: Will my bots keep working if my phone or internet goes offline?
faq.a: Yes. Each bot runs on its own isolated 24/7 cloud computer in secure data centers, meaning tasks, scheduled checks, and web scraping proceed uninterrupted even during local power or network outages.

faq.q: How does Ceyo integrate with Telegram?
faq.a: You can connect Ceyo directly to personal Telegram chats or invite multiple bots into group chats, where they collaborate alongside your team as specialized researchers, coders, and assistants.

faq.q: What languages and document formats can Ceyo handle?
faq.a: Ceyo communicates fluently in English and dozens of world languages, making it easy to translate foreign supplier manuals, analyze overseas contracts, and process PDFs, CSVs, or Word documents.

faq.q: How does Ceyo interact with my existing software?
faq.a: Ceyo connects with over 1,000 popular business applications, including Google Sheets, Gmail, Notion, Slack, and calendars, enabling your agents to read and update records automatically.
